Home / Home View
Display Views — Home

Home — Your everyday main view.

Your morning check, in one click. The collapsible widget dashboard at the top gives you today's status at a glance, and from a task list automatically sorted by due date, handle status changes and comment replies right here.

Collapsible Widget Dashboard

Overdue tasks, recently completed tasks, recently viewed tasks, and per-project counts shown as cards at the top. Drag to reorder, and collapse with the ▲/▼ button.

Instantly clear with due-date grouping

Automatically grouped into overdue, today, within a week, and more. Color makes risk level obvious at a glance

Quick Filters & Full-Text Search

One-click filtering (keys 1–5). Search across titles, keys, and assignees

Bulk Actions & Right-Click Menu

Multi-select to change status, due date, and assignee all at once. Right-click for instant edits to title, details, completion, due date, and more

Comment notifications mean nothing slips through

New comments from others automatically float to the top of the list. The 💬 button lights up yellow so you notice right away

Cut your morning check down to 1 minute.

It's automatically sorted by due date the moment you open it, so you can dive straight into today's work without a second thought.

Backlog My Tasks

A Chrome extension that lets you check and manage all your assigned Backlog tasks across multiple spaces in one place. With 7 display views and a Project Dashboard, everyday task management and tracking team progress become effortless.
